title: Metadata-Driven AI: An Architectural Pattern for Sustainable Data Analysis with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.24661v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) let users analyse data in natural language, either by giving the data to the model to read directly or by having the model generate code to process it. Both routes send the data, or fragments of it, to the model; both pay for inference on every run; and the code a model writes to answer a question is usually discarded once the question is answered. We present Metadata-Driven AI, an architectural pattern that keeps the data away from the model and turns each analysis into a reusable program. Only metadata (not the actual data) crosses a one-way inference boundary to the LLM. The program the LLM returns runs next to the data and is kept, so that inference is paid once per analysis rather than once per run. We describe the pattern together with a simple cost model, a measurement of how little information crosses the boundary on public datasets, and a benchmark showing that a small, locally hosted model can serve

translated_title: 元数据驱动的AI：一种基于大语言模型的可持续数据分析架构模式
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）使用户能够用自然语言分析数据，既可以将数据直接提供给模型读取，也可以让模型生成代码来处理数据。但这两种方式都会将数据或其片段发送给模型；每次运行都需要支付推理成本；而且模型为回答问题而编写的代码通常在问题得到解答后就被丢弃了。我们提出了元数据驱动的AI（Metadata-Driven AI），这是一种将数据与模型分离、并将每次分析转化为可复用程序的架构模式。在该模式中，只有元数据（而非实际数据）通过单向推理边界传递给LLM，LLM返回的程序在数据旁边运行并被保留下来，因此推理成本每次分析只需支付一次，而不是每次运行都需支付。我们对该模式进行了描述，并给出了一个简单的成本模型、对公开数据集上跨越该边界的信息量之少的测量结果，以及一个表明小型本地托管模型可以胜任该任务的基准测试。
tldr: 该论文提出“元数据驱动的AI”架构模式，只让元数据而非实际数据跨越单向边界进入LLM，并将模型生成的分析程序保留复用，从而将推理成本从每次运行一次降低为每次分析一次，实现更经济、更私密且可持续的自然语言数据分析。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "Metadata-Driven AI," an architectural pattern where only metadata (not actual data) crosses a one-way boundary to the LLM and the generated analysis programs are kept for reuse, paying for inference once per analysis instead of once per run, enabling sustainable, privacy-preserving data analysis.
